content.introduction: Asia's major stock markets include the Hang Seng in Hong Kong, Nikkei 225 in Japan, and Kospi in South Korea. Recent trends show declines in these markets due to tech sector uncertainties. For detailed data, visit the Wall Street Journal or Asia Financial.
body: Hong Kong: Hang Seng, Japan: Nikkei 225, China: Shanghai Composite, India: S&P BSE Sensex, Australia: S&P/ASX, S. Korea: KOSPI, Global Dow DJIA Futures.

# Latest: Asia Stock Market News. Seoul’s Kospi Stocks Sink as Tech Giants Hit Again. Taiwan Raids Tech Firms Over Smuggling Nvidia Chips to China. Prosecutors in Taiwan raid Super Micro and tech firms in probe on servers with Nvidia chips sent to China. And Japan says it's ready to act on the yen. Kospi, Nikkei, Hang Seng Sink as Tech Doubts Rock Asia Again. The Kospi in Seoul plunged again on Friday, along with most other Asian markets. A groundswell against AI in the US is driving doubts about the global tech boom, which has lifted chip stocks to record highs. The Kospi, Nikkei, Hang Seng, plus most other markets in Asia were dragged down on Tuesday by doubts over huge investments in AI and SpaceX. Oil prices fell again on Thursday after President Trump and his Iranian counterpart signed a peace deal, which led to tankers starting to go through the Strait of Hormuz. Asia stock market insights, analysis, and guides from Asia Financial’s market and new economy experts.
